info.name: RideX API v1
info.description:
The mobile API used by the Rider and Driver apps. Regenerate this file after changing routes: `php artisan ridex:api-collection`.

1. Set the `baseUrl` variable to `{APP_URL}/api/v1`.

2. Sign in with **auth.otp.send**, then **auth.otp.verify** (in demo mode: +1 5550000001 with code 123456), and copy `data.token` into the `token` variable.

3. Every response uses the same envelope: `{success, message, data, meta, errors, error_code}`. Send `X-Locale` (`en`, `ar`, …) for translated messages.
